== Title ==
<span lang="ja">予期せぬ損傷</span><ref name="jp-face" /><ref>[[WED-9-M1 'Bantha' Droid (Japanese)#Card Text|Japanese WED-9-M1 game text]] names the card it cancels.</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">任意の星系カードに配備する。相手の宇宙船１隻を対象に選ぶ。対象は戦闘力＝０、没収＝０となる。対象がこのカードと同じ場所に移動したなら、相手は運命数を引く。運命数＞２なら、このカードはキャンセルされる。そうでなければ、次の移動フェイズにもう一度運命数を引く。</span>

The source frame shows the last readable sentence through its period. The bottom edge of the text box is cropped.<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-222o-Video.jpg|Japanese card detail from the complete-set video]].</ref>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">宇宙船は時として、戦闘でダメージを受け、修理と補給を受けるまで使用不能となる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Unexpected Damage.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on any system. Target one opposing starship. The target's power and forfeit become 0. When it moves to the same location as this card, your opponent draws destiny. If it exceeds 2, cancel this card. Otherwise, your opponent draws destiny again during the next move phase.

'''Lore:''' Starships can take damage in combat and remain unusable until repaired and resupplied.

== Statistics ==
